Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference rollout. We're planning a compact "Day 0 Jumpstart" to get stakeholders aligned and confirm access before the implementation sprint. Below is the proposed plan and asks — please confirm by EOD so we can finalize the calendar and bridge.

Proposed Day 0 (UTC-7):
- 30 minutes total (30m) — Intro + environment readiness + immediate blockers
- 10:00–10:05 — Quick intros / goals (Samira / Tom + Ben)
- 10:05–10:15 — Access & SSO confirmation (MedNova IT)
- 10:15–10:25 — Implementation playbook highlights & owner mapping (Monica / Priyom)
- 10:25–10:30 — Next steps / immediate action items and confirm sprint 0 start

Hosts / owners (tentative):
- Customer host: Samira Khan (MedNova)
- Redwood lead: Ben Carter (CS)
- Technical lead: Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer)
- Ops & runbook: Priyom Das (Onboarding)

Attendee ask: please confirm the final list of internal attendees (names and emails) and add any compliance/IT contacts we should loop in. If you prefer a different timezone or need 45m, say so and we'll adjust.

Join links & attachments:
- Bridge (primary): Dial-in + Google Meet (will send calendar invite once attendees confirmed)
- Playbook: redwood-implementation-playbook-v1.pdf (attached)
- Calendar stub: jumpstart-bridge.ics (attached)

Pre-flight checklist (quick):
1) SSO/Okta test accounts for 1 developer (MedNova IT) — confirm if ready
2) L4 firewall egress rules for API endpoints — confirm if blocked
3) Access to a representative dataset (anonymized) for demo tokens — optional but helpful

If you can reply with attendee confirmations and a preferred contact for SSO testing by 5pm PT, we'll push the calendar invite and a condensed agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

—Ben
